acceptanceCriteria: The Go adapter ships a versioned LPCV-V0-021 capability manifest and a test that fails when it is absent or mismatched; STR-V0-004's traceability row cites it with no 'partial'.
A test proves the STR-V0-011 no-other-reader rule (a mutation that adds a second reader fails it); the traceability row cites it.
No accepted requirement text changes; focused tests and doc-gates pass.
body: From V1-1257 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#988): AC1-AC3 promotion measurements are met (parity 0 UNEXPLAINED over 50 pairs, 20/20 bar #915-#938, timing observed), but docs/SPEC-DRIVEN-DEVELOPMENT.md defines `implemented` as every in-scope requirement having executable evidence. STR-V0-004's traceability row says 'no versioned LPCV-V0-021 capability manifest yet (partial)'; STR-V0-011 holds 'by construction' with no test. Orchestrator decision 2026-10-16 (owner delegation): fund the evidence rather than scope the requirements out of V0. Use the status word `implemented` (no 'delivered' status exists). After this lands, a short lane flips session-test-runner-v0.md to implemented citing PR #988 evidence and closes V1-1257. Open reading for that lane: AFP-V0-030 trip treated as non-latching (2026-10-15 hosted Set-up-job trip cleared); if review holds it latching, a new epoch needs a .github change (owner approval).
title: corvint test: give STR-V0-004 (versioned LPCV-V0-021 capability manifest for the Go adapter) and STR-V0-011 (no-other-reader rule) executable evidence so STR-V0 can be promoted
